# Bloub avatar engine

From https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub at b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749 (MIT).
Only the framework-independent engine and its dependencies are included. Imports use Jaz aliases; upstream geometry and timing are preserved. Jaz renders the sampled frames in VoiceVisualizer.tsx.
